# Thanh Nhã Shop

> Hand-polished Vietnamese lacquerware (sơn mài) made in Hội An, Quảng Nam, Vietnam, sold online and shipped worldwide in padded boxes.

Decorative pieces only: lidded lacquer boxes, serving trays, decorative bowls, mother-of-pearl coaster sets and eggshell-inlay wall panels. Prices in US dollars. Orders are placed through the order form and confirmed by e-mail with a payment link; nothing is charged before that.

## Pages
- [Lacquer boxes](https://thanhnhashop.com/lacquer-boxes.html): small 10 cm ($28) and large 20 cm ($64) lidded boxes, coats, sanding, care
- [Trays and bowls](https://thanhnhashop.com/trays-and-bowls.html): 40 cm serving tray ($72), 18 cm bowl ($36), coaster set of 6 ($42)
- [Eggshell panels](https://thanhnhashop.com/eggshell-panels.html): 40 × 40 cm eggshell-inlay panel ($155), how the shell is laid, hanging
- [Order lacquerware](https://thanhnhashop.com/order-lacquerware.html): the order form
- [Our workshop in Hội An](https://thanhnhashop.com/our-workshop-in-hoi-an.html)
- [Delivery worldwide](https://thanhnhashop.com/delivery-worldwide.html)
- [Returns and refunds](https://thanhnhashop.com/returns-policy.html)
